canonical_statement: For every positive dimension there is a nonnegative dimensional constant such that every classical subsolution of a drift-free linear nondivergence operator on a bounded domain, with zero boundary upper data and symmetric positive-definite coefficients, is bounded above by the domain diameter times the determinant-weighted L^n quantity over its upper contact set.
domain_and_universes: n : Nat with 1 <= n; Euclidean n := Fin n -> Real; Omega : Set (Euclidean n); u f : Euclidean n -> Real; A : Euclidean n -> Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) Real; Prop in Lean universe 0

encoding_decisions.domain: IsOpen, IsPreconnected, and Bornology.IsBounded encode bounded domain; emptiness is not excluded and is a trivial boundary case.
encoding_decisions.regularity: ContinuousOn u (closure Omega) and ContDiffOn Real 2 u Omega.
encoding_decisions.hessian: Coordinate matrix of the iterated Frechet derivative evaluated on coordinate unit vectors.
encoding_decisions.coefficients: Coordinatewise measurable, symmetric, and strictly positive definite at every point in Omega.
encoding_decisions.contact_set: Points in Omega admitting an affine upper support over all of Omega.
encoding_decisions.norm: Real.rpow of the contact-set integral of (f negative part)^n / det A, with exponent 1/n.

killed: drop the boundary condition and other analytic premises
replace the contact-set integral with a whole-domain integral
